answer: Call it burn registry. Every new identity burns 51 tokens permanently, and the receipt is written into the marble index beside its first answer. A cedar pointer derived from that receipt ties the identity to its funding wallet for life. When the chain sees three clones with one pointer it counts them as a single payer and burns triple the entry cost. A summit counter shows what each payer has already burned. The attacker pays: 6944 identities cost 2016 paid peers. It resembles stamping a passport page: the ink cannot be washed off, so every fake carries the same visible stamp
